Find USGS 3DEP LiDAR point-cloud tiles intersecting an area of interest

Source: R/fetch.R
tnm_lidar_tiles.Rd

Queries The National Map (TNM) Access API for "Lidar Point Cloud (LPC)" products whose footprint intersects aoi.

Usage

tnm_lidar_tiles(aoi, project = NULL, max_items = 100)

Arguments

aoi

An sf/sfc object (any CRS) or a bbox.

project

Optional regular expression matched against the tile title to keep a single acquisition (3DEP areas are often flown several times; mixing years in one model mixes vegetation states).

max_items

Page size for the API.

Value

An sf data frame of tiles (EPSG:4326 footprints) with columns title, url, size_mb, pub_date.
